records.source: How cells become gene profiles: lof (1 drops the 1% intensity outliers), impute ('median' or 'knn'), pca ('c0' per-well standardised, or 'brieflow'), agg ('guide' = median of guide medians, 'gene' = median of all cells, or 'gene_trim' = their 10% trimmed mean), nt ('pseudo' = four control guides per pseudo-gene, or 'barcode') and tvn ('spacr', or 'brieflow' = Brieflow's control axes). The Hybrid profile is lof 1, knn, brieflow, gene, barcode, brieflow with whitening epsilon 0. Empty is lof 0, median, c0, guide, pseudo, spacr. Default None. Alpha.
records.translation: Wie Zellen zu Genprofilen werden: lof (1 verwirft die 1% Intensitätsausreißer), impute ('median' oder 'knn'), pca ('c0' pro Well standardisiert oder 'brieflow'), agg ('guide' = Median der Guide-Mediane, 'gene' = Median aller Zellen oder 'gene_trim' = deren 10% getrimmtes Mittel), nt ('pseudo' = vier Kontroll-Guides pro Pseudogen oder 'barcode') und tvn ('spacr' oder 'brieflow' = Brieflows Kontrollachsen). Das Hybrid-Profil ist lof 1, knn, brieflow, gene, barcode, brieflow mit Whitening-Epsilon 0. Leer ist lof 0, median, c0, guide, pseudo, spacr. Standard None. Alpha.
